## About
CJ Automotive Repair is a neighborhood shop on E Mission Blvd in Pomona. Our ASE-certified mechanics service all makes and models, and they keep taking training courses so they stay current with modern automotive technology.
When something is wrong with your car, it can be stressful, especially if you don't know what's going on under the hood. We explain what we find in plain terms, and our maintenance follows the recommendations in your owner's manual to help you avoid major repairs later on.
Give us a call with questions about pricing, timing or anything else, Monday through Friday.

## Services
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes for all makes and models.
- Tune-ups: Vehicle tune-ups to keep your car running properly.
- Transmission services: Transmission service for all makes and models.
- Maintenance services: Maintenance that follows your owner's manual, so you can protect your car and help avoid major repairs down the road.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Our mechanics are trained and qualified to service all makes and models.

Q: What happens if something still isn't right after a repair?
A: If you're not completely satisfied, we'll gladly re-evaluate your car.

Q: What are your hours of operation?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
